title: Rizal Memorial Baseball Stadium renovation races toward East Asia Cup deadline
summary: The Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) and the Philippine Amateur Baseball Association (PABA) are fast-tracking the renovation of the Rizal Memorial Baseball Stadium in Manila.
